_comment: Copy to webvpn.json beside webvpn-server(.exe), or simply run `webvpn-server init`. Generate the user hash with `webvpn-server hash-password` and replace the placeholder below.
_comment_hsts: The self-signed certificate `init` makes is not trusted by a browser; keep hsts false until a CA certificate is installed.
_comment_headers: blocked_* arrays are regular expressions matched against the whole header name, case-insensitively. Built-in hop-by-hop/security headers always apply.
_comment_cors: cors_origins lists the exact http(s) origins allowed to call /proxy/ cross-origin, e.g. "https://portal.example". Use "null" for a file:// page or a sandboxed iframe; * is not accepted. Only list origins you trust as much as the portal itself. Once set, the proxy owns CORS and discards upstream Access-Control-* headers.
